title: The limiting reagent
caption: Six H₂ molecules and two O₂ molecules: by 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O the two O₂ can use only four H₂, making four H₂O. Oxygen runs out first, so it is limiting; two H₂ are left over.
alt: Before: six hydrogen molecules and two oxygen molecules. After: four water molecules and two leftover hydrogen molecules.
description: After: 4 H₂O and 2 unreacted H₂. Oxygen was used up, so it was the limiting reagent.
